title: job.failed (v1)
description: An attempt failed. Published by the worker host after uploading what exists (logs!), or by job-orchestrator when it gives up (deadline passed, lease lost, message dead-lettered after max attempts). Routing key `job.<kind>.<jobId>.status.v1`, AMQP type `events.v1.JobFailed`, persistent, with confirms. `final: false` means the orchestrator will retry (a new attempt follows); `final: true` moves the job to `failed`.

final.description: true when no further attempt will be made.

artifacts.description: Whatever the attempt uploaded before failing (logs, partial results).
